parsed.internal_thinking: Jimmy is offering 1 Wood for 1 Ore. I currently have 1 Sheep, 1 Ore, and 1 Wood (total 3 cards). I need Brick and Wood to build roads toward the 3:1 port (N51). While Jimmy is in the lead with 3 VP, Claude is also a threat and hostile. However, Ore is extremely scarce in this game (Claude only has 2 and 3, Jimmy has none on his settlements, and I have the only decent Ore on 5). Giving Jimmy Ore helps him build a City or Development cards, which is dangerous since he's at 3 VP. My own Ore is vital for my future City or Development cards. Trading a rare resource (Ore) for a common one (Wood) when the opponent is leading is not a smart move, even if Wood helps my road progress. I'll reject.
parsed.note_to_self: Rejected Jimmy's Wood for Ore trade. Ore is too valuable to give to the leader (3 VP) when I only have one. I need to find a way to get Brick, which is the real bottleneck for my expansion to the port.
parsed.say_outloud: ג'ימי, אני אשמח לעץ אבל אבן זה יקר מדי כרגע, במיוחד כשאתה כבר ב-3 נקודות. אני אשמור אותה בינתיים.
